hooks.statusMessage: Revisando que no salgan datos personales ni secretos...

hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/frontend/*) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/frontend" && ./node_modules/.bin/prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$f";; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
